name: ring-text
title: Ring Text
description: Text runs around a tilted 3D band that spins, reading on the near side and mirrored on the far side.
useWhen: A headline needs a dimensional object next to it, and the object itself should carry a short phrase.
A tagline, a feature name or a slogan should loop continuously in a compact spot.
You want a badge-like accent that reads as 3D without any 3D library or assets.
avoidWhen: The phrase should scroll flat across the frame: use infinite-marquee.
The text should pop out of the plane as a solid extruded word: use extrude-pop.
The motion should be ribbons bursting outward rather than a steady ring: use radial-burst.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Phrase that runs around the ring.

variables.label: Separator
variables.description: Mark between laps of the phrase.

variables.label: Radius
variables.description: Ring radius in reference pixels (1280×720 stage); a long phrase grows it.

variables.label: Tilt
variables.description: How far the ring leans toward the viewer, in degrees.

variables.label: Roll
variables.description: In-plane rotation of the ring, in degrees.

variables.label: Frames per turn
variables.description: Frames for one full spin (30 fps).
